topic: Direct membrane regularization and the reach of the existing spike-activity objective

source_inspection.title: RecDis-SNN: Rectifying Membrane Potential Distribution for Directly Training Spiking Neural Networks
source_inspection.read_scope: Publisher abstract and metadata. The linked PDF returned HTTP 403; the detailed loss was not audited.
source_inspection.supported_point: The authors propose a membrane-distribution loss and report improvements in directly trained SNNs.
source_inspection.boundary: This supports investigating a direct potential objective, not reproducing its formula or assuming an effect in our language model.

source_inspection.title: Membrane Potential Distribution Adjustment and Parametric Surrogate Gradient in Spiking Neural Networks
source_inspection.read_scope: Introduction, LIF mechanism, quantization discussion and section 3.1 with equations 4-6. External code and full experimental results were not audited.
source_inspection.supported_point: The method adds a symmetric distribution-divergence objective and separately adapts surrogate parameters in classification experiments.
source_inspection.boundary: Our signed subtractive-reset cell and continuous emission differ. The candidate point penalty is our own simpler objective, not the paper method or evidence of a language benefit.

source_inspection.title: Membrane Potential Batch Normalization for Spiking Neural Networks
source_inspection.read_scope: Neuron equations, sections 3.2 and 4.1-4.4, the training/inference algorithm, threshold-folding expression and classification ablation table. External code was not run.
source_inspection.supported_point: The method normalizes the membrane before firing and folds trained normalization into thresholds for inference.
source_inspection.boundary: Adapting it to one causal live learner requires explicit statistics and update semantics; its classification results do not supply those semantics.

failed_additional_access.reason: Browser rejected application/octet-stream; no additional full-paper reading is claimed.

engineering_conclusion: First quantify the optional activity objective on preserved signed-cell traces, then consider a direct squared-excess potential penalty with unchanged forward computation. Scalar/recurrence checks are insufficient for language or retention claims.
